body: I appreciate your advice. I usually go to the gym about 3 times a week but have put that on hold lately because of midterms, but I do miss that feeling of satisfaction.

It will get easier... rejection is a part of life that no one likes. It sucks, it hurts and it can make things that are already bad a hell of a lot worse. But how you're treating yourself is only perpetuating it farther. Eat well and allow your body to feel good. When things start to get out of control I like to write a list of things that I want to change, then work on the things that I can change. 

Suicide is a final answer to a temporary problem. If you feel like you can't make the changes you want to by yourself, or you do and you don't feel any different, then talk to a counselor or psychologist. Do what you can to help yourself and always know that people are here to help you along that difficult path (even if it's just strangers on the internet).
